AIG::/job/London/Client-Director--12-mon.experience_required: Extensive track record managing major corporate insurance clients; corporate insurance programme and sales/business-development experience.

mandatory: Extensive major-corporate client relationship experience in insurance
Sales/business development and broker relationship experience

AIG::/job/London/Client-Director--12-mon.decision_scope_and_ownership: Own retention, cross-sell/new-business pipeline and account strategy for major corporate insurance clients.
AIG::/job/London/Client-Director--12-mon.seniority_evidence: Director-level client ownership; JD asks for an extensive track record and established London insurance-market profile.
AIG::/job/London/Client-Director--12-mon.rationale: Commercially senior insurance-sales role. The work is centred on retention, new business and insurance-market relationships, with mandatory domain depth far beyond the target profile.

AIG::/job/London/Data---Digital-Analyst_.experience_required: Experience in data, digital, product or business analysis within insurance; understanding of underwriting workflows and data/digital platforms.

mandatory: Ability to translate business needs into requirements/user stories/process models
Understanding of underwriting workflows and business data platforms

AIG::/job/London/Data---Digital-Analyst_.decision_scope_and_ownership: Bridge business stakeholders and platform teams, shape requirements/backlogs and support delivery/adoption of digital and data capabilities.
AIG::/job/London/Data---Digital-Analyst_.seniority_evidence: Analyst role with cross-functional delivery ownership but no people management or numeric tenure floor.
AIG::/job/London/Data---Digital-Analyst_.rationale: Functionally an excellent BA/digital-transformation match, but the JD explicitly asks for insurance-domain experience and underwriting-process knowledge. For London, that domain gap keeps it below the strong-match threshold.

AIG::/job/London/International-Distribut.experience_required: Analytical/project-support experience; P&C insurance understanding is expected, while commercial-insurance experience is phrased as preferred.

mandatory: Power BI, Excel and Salesforce familiarity
Strong analytical/quantitative skills and structured problem solving
Ability to support project management and stakeholder needs

AIG::/job/London/International-Distribut.decision_scope_and_ownership: Provide strategic analytics for distribution leaders, build management/broker decks, KPI reporting and dashboards, and support broker initiatives.
AIG::/job/London/International-Distribut.seniority_evidence: Analyst scope, no people-management requirement and no numeric experience minimum; responsibilities are execution/analytics rather than senior ownership.
AIG::/job/London/International-Distribut.rationale: Strong overlap with client strategy, KPI analysis, Power BI/Excel/Salesforce, executive presentations and project support. The main gap is P&C insurance knowledge, but the functional fit is strong enough to clear the London threshold.

AIG::/job/London/International-Head-of-F.experience_required: Extensive claims/fraud/recovery expertise plus proven leadership of regional teams and industry credibility.

mandatory: Extensive fraud/recovery and insurance claims expertise
Leadership of large geographically distributed teams

AIG::/job/London/International-Head-of-F.decision_scope_and_ownership: Own the international fraud and recovery programme across five regions, strategy, analytics, vendors, budgets and staffing.
AIG::/job/London/International-Head-of-F.seniority_evidence: International Head role managing regional managers across five regions with pay, staffing and performance-management authority.
AIG::/job/London/International-Head-of-F.rationale: Clearly executive/senior insurance-claims leadership with specialised fraud/recovery expertise and direct people-management responsibility; far outside current seniority and functional target.

AIG::/job/London/Lead-Analyst----Legal-E.experience_required: 5+ years of general-insurance capital modelling plus quantitative MSc/qualified actuary or equivalent and Solvency II internal-model expertise.

mandatory: MSc quantitative field, qualified actuary or equivalent
5+ years capital modelling in General Insurance

AIG::/job/London/Lead-Analyst----Legal-E.decision_scope_and_ownership: Produce and govern regulatory/internal capital models, model outputs, controls, validation and regulator/committee reporting.
AIG::/job/London/Lead-Analyst----Legal-E.seniority_evidence: Lead Analyst requiring 5+ years of specialised insurance capital-modelling experience and actuarial/quantitative credentials.
AIG::/job/London/Lead-Analyst----Legal-E.rationale: Although the numeric floor is exactly five years, this is a specialist actuarial/capital-modelling role requiring credentials and domain experience the user does not have.
